label: is the rehearsal for what happens at
notes: RR 189: a rim merchant hit water at ninety feet forty miles out and had a Warden of the Third Rank on his spoil-heap inside eleven days. Ground sealed, shaft capped with plain-salt and mortar, compensation paid at the assessed salt price, survey never begun, seal still in force. It is the exact shape of what is coming at the centre, already done once cleanly and never challenged - everyone about to argue about the Fourth Article is really arguing about Ferrant. The one difference: he had no crossing licence for the ground he stood on, and Ysoly does.
